turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
s, you’ve got some wiggle room. You can reschedule your next delivery to an earlier available date by:

Logging into your account
Going to Plan → Your Next Box → Manage Delivery → Reschedule
Picking an earlier date and clicking Reschedule Delivery

Just be sure to do this before your order deadline shown on your Plan page.
